name: smooth_l1_loss
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::smooth_l1_loss(Tensor self, Tensor target, int reduction=Mean, float beta=1.0) -> Tensor. Computes Smooth L1 loss with none, mean, or sum reduction without mutating or aliasing the functional inputs. Tests cover zero-sized through four-dimensional tensors, noncontiguous and broadcast inputs, beta zero and positive beta values, special floating values, functional autograd, input non-mutation, negative-beta rejection, the out overload's identity, storage, and resize behavior, and the legacy backward contract including broadcast, scalar-grad, beta-zero, and error cases.
